map.25°C：e_s=6.1078×exp(17.27×25/(25+237.3)): 25°C: e_s=6.1078×exp(17.27×25/(25+237.3)) ≈31.7 hPa; 30°C → ≈42.4 hPa, so a 5°C rise in temperature increases the saturation vapor pressure by about one third.
map.0°C 时 e_s≈6.1 hPa，20°C≈23.4 hPa，升温使空气持水能: At 0°C e_s≈6.1 hPa and at 20°C ≈23.4 hPa; warming makes the air's water-holding capacity rise nearly exponentially, the root cause of "hotter feels muggier".
map.经验公式在 0–50°C 精度足够且易算，气象水文常用；更宽温区用 Goff-G: The empirical formula is accurate enough from 0-50°C and easy to compute, commonly used in meteorology and hydrology; for wider temperature ranges use Goff-Gratch.
